label.zh: 研究成功：可招募泰坦巨兽
label.en: Study succeeds: Titanic Beasts can be recruited

note.zh: 监视版本（亲外）另清除星球上的泰坦巨兽障碍。
note.en: The Monitoring (xenophile) version also clears the planet's Titanic Life blockers.

colony_mod.101.evidence: events/colony_events_3.txt:283-322; the second EXCELLENT option requires carrier flag nice_titan_study set by colony_mod.2.c.

note.zh: 生成敌对的泰坦巨兽陆军，星球进入驱逐清洗状态，直到这些陆军被消灭。
note.en: Hostile titan armies spawn and the planet is set to displacement purge until they are killed.

colony_mod.102.evidence: events/colony_events_3.txt:324-373; colony_mod.103 (hidden, 375-394) clears the purge type when a titanic_guardian_army dies.

notes.zh: 审阅注：三种研究互为替代——普通（3500，成功70%）、亲外的“监视”（5000，成功90%）、排外或蜂巢的“解剖”（2500，成功50%，并立即获得“美味巨兽”类修正）。拒绝则无事发生。
notes.en: Review note: three alternative studies — normal (3500, 70% success), xenophile Monitoring (5000, 90%), xenophobe/hive Necropsies (2500, 50%, plus an immediate 'Delicious Titans'-type modifier). Declining ends the story.

scope.zh: 泰坦巨兽殖民地事件、三个研究项目与两种结果，从合并的修正事件故事中拆出。
scope.en: The Titanic Life colony event, its three study projects and two results, split out of the merged modifier-event story.
